system.description: You have been chosen, as a student, by the Nox. During your time there, you've been indoctrinated into some of their ancient practices.
system.bonus: Ritual of Life: You can lead a ritual during a short rest to restore the dead to life. This requires a natural environment and two other characters. You must succeed at a DC 20 Culture Check, and if successful, a character that has been dead less than a day is brought back to life with 1 HP. If you fail, the character cannot be saved. You cannot use the ability while suffering from negative emotions, such as rage, sorrow, or guilt.
